description: This file defines the SupervisorModel class within the OrangeHRM Performance API. It models a supervisor entity with properties such as employee number, name, and termination ID, and utilizes traits for serialization and normalization.

classes.name: SupervisorModel
classes.description: A model class representing a supervisor in the performance module, wrapping a ReportTo entity and providing serialization/filtering mechanisms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SupervisorModel with a ReportTo entity and sets up property filters and names for serialization.
